label: Codex approval review: bulk-run preflight, SQL snapshot tooling for disposable DB batch
summary: Approved a sequence of read-only/reversible Codex actions supporting an authorized bulk workflow-comparison run: a local read-only preflight script (Windows recovery receipts, backup hash, SQL sessions, patient row diffs between legacy/hms2), running that preflight, a PowerShell helper creating validated read-only SQL Server snapshots of the two disposable databases, and a follow-up snapshot-creation-and-exact-row-verification helper. All allowed as medium-risk/high-authorization: no destructive mutation or external data transfer, scoped to disposable test infrastructure already covered by prior user authorization for the bulk run.
